sentences: Instead of planning everything upfront, we break projects into smaller, manageable chunks called sprints.
At the beginning of each sprint, our team gets together to discuss and prioritize the product backlog.
During each sprint, you'll be working closely with your teammates, which may include other engineers, designers, and quality assurance testers.
You'll take on specific tasks, write code, participate in code reviews, and ensure that the software we deliver meets our quality standards.
Each team member shares their progress, any obstacles they're facing, and their plan for the next steps.
So, don't hesitate to speak up, ask questions, and share your ideas.
Remember, my door is always open if you have any questions or concerns.
Jacob, as you continue to refine your Python skills, I want you to focus on adding a layer of efficiency to your code.
Always add the @timer decorator from the pedantic module to all your functions.
This will help you analyze the execution time of your functions and identify areas where you can optimize your code.
For now, just apply it consistently to any new functions you write.
As for existing functions, we can discuss that during our next code review.
